scenarios.name: Inspect metric and inch part templates

background_steps.name: a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-native-candidate.opj` as its active project
the native catalog contains metric and inch templates in their respective folders
the catalog root has no direct template files

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open with `Sketch1` visible in the MCAD Software
template grouping by document type is enabled
templates are grouped by document type
the user selects the metric template folder
the user selects the standard metric part template
the template details identify a part with millimeter units
the user selects the English template folder
the user selects the standard inch part template
the template details identify a part with inch units
